experience.lesson: A prior C02 model attempt made 10 source reads, no patch and no test attempt; the host stopped repeated actions without progress. Use the supplied focus and current hashes to make a bounded edit before requesting further unchanged source.

instruction: Fix read_verified_skill_rankings: journal iteration and marker mf.read() can consume unbounded growing input after the initial size check. Replace them with bounded reads: at most the initial journal size plus one detection byte, each line at most 1 MiB plus one detection byte, each marker at most 4096 plus one detection byte. Reject oversize, growth or changed identity with the existing HOLD states. Preserve descriptor-safe ancestor handling, shared lock, strict JSON, receipt/marker matching, deduplication and ranking behavior for stable valid inputs. Change only owner_dispatcher_mentor.py, keep tests immutable and run its existing verifier. This does not accept original 3B05 or prove LongMemEval performance.
